metaTitle: Custom Heavyweight Nursing Scrubs | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom heavyweight nursing scrubs in bulk for your team. Durable, professional, and made to last. Get a quote today.
introHtml: Heavyweight nursing scrubs are built for demanding shifts in hospitals, clinics, and urgent care centers. The thicker fabric resists wrinkles, holds up to frequent washing, and provides a more structured fit than standard-weight scrubs. For bulk buyers equipping an entire department, heavyweight options mean your team looks polished longer without fading or pilling. Choose from reinforced stitching, multiple pocket configurations, and easy-care polyester-cotton blends that keep their shape. Add your facility logo or department name via embroidery or screen printing for a cohesive, professional appearance.
heroAltText: Custom heavyweight nursing scrubs in navy blue with embroidered logo, featuring reinforced seams and multiple pockets.
